question: Does the current abliterated-checkpoint selection surface include the already model-specifically measured Josiefied Qwen3.5-0.8B snapshot as a target candidate without incorrectly promoting it to winner?

observations.finding: Current project evidence binds a model-specific measurement package to Goekdeniz-Guelmez/Josiefied-Qwen3.5-0.8B-gabliterated-v1 at snapshot 591852bda6e1979f59e4b0f5ee2919697b12e936. Geometry, binding, semantic-rank, read/write, alphabet, codec, structural-task and context-invariance measurements are explicitly scoped to that exact measured snapshot.
The current C1 protocol already names the same Josiefied snapshot as its measured starting point and preserves the negative structural probe as a bounded baseline rather than a model-size verdict.

The newer abliterated checkpoint audit correctly reclassifies official Base/post-trained checkpoints as controls and discovers three external abliterated candidate repositories, but it does not list the already measured Josiefied snapshot in its candidate matrix.

The exact checkpoint gate still contains only Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base and Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B and requires selection to remain UNRESOLVED_MATCHED_PILOT_REQUIRED. It cannot represent an abliterated TARGET role.

external_current_crosscheck.finding: Official Base currently exposes verified head dc7cdfe and the same 0.8B/24-layer/1024-hidden Qwen3.5 architecture family used by the project control pin.
Official post-trained currently exposes verified head 2fc0636 and remains an appropriate non-abliterated control, not the Trigger-2 abliterated target.

The repository remains available and identifies itself as a gabliterated fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B; current project model-specific measurement evidence remains stronger than the model card for Clay-specific J-Space claims.

artifact_reclassification.revision_reason: It discovers unmeasured external target candidates but omits the already exact-snapshot-measured Josiefied donor from the selection matrix.

artifact_reclassification.successor: checkpoint candidate gate v2 with TARGET versus CONTROL roles
artifact_reclassification.revision_reason: Exact control identities are useful but cannot satisfy the abliterated target constraint.

artifact_reclassification.successor: matched target/control pilot preserving exact snapshot scope
artifact_reclassification.revision_reason: No revision to measurements; only their checkpoint-selection role is upgraded from passive evidence source to measured target-candidate evidence.

artifact_reclassification.revision_reason: It has uniquely valuable model-specific Clay measurements but no current winner status, no loader-consumption proof for a new run, and no matched retention/selection pilot.

decision.why: Model-specific prior measurements make Josiefied the strongest measured abliterated donor, not an automatically superior training start. A winner still requires exact immutable artifact identity plus matched low-refusal, cognition-retention, Hyperposition, variable-N, DB/Claude re-entry and J-Space causal evaluation without holdout leakage.

matched_pilot_law: Keep Base and official post-trained checkpoints as controls rather than allowing them to satisfy TARGET.
Include the measured Josiefied snapshot as a target candidate but preserve all prior measurement scope exactly.
Do not use model-card refusal claims as Clay winner evidence.
Separate low-refusal objective from cognition/protocol/J-Space retention.
Freeze calibration/validation surfaces before selection and keep final holdout untouched.
Do not grant loader/runtime/J-Space/training credit from repository existence or historical measurements alone.

new_nonpromoting_training_blueprints.prompt_pattern: A checkpoint selector discovers several newly labeled abliterated repositories but omits an exact-snapshot candidate that already has model-specific causal/geometry measurements in the project.
new_nonpromoting_training_blueprints.required_target: Do not select from the incomplete matrix. Admit the measured snapshot as a role-typed target candidate, preserve its evidence scope, and still require the same immutable identity and matched-pilot gates before winner selection.

new_nonpromoting_training_blueprints.prompt_pattern: An official Base or post-trained checkpoint has stronger hash provenance than the abliterated targets, so a selector proposes it as the training TARGET even though current authority requires an abliterated approximately-0.8B target.
new_nonpromoting_training_blueprints.required_target: Reject role collapse. Keep official checkpoints as matched controls; provenance strength cannot silently change the required target class.

next_exact_action: Converge checkpoint-candidate gate v2 with explicit TARGET/CONTROL roles and add the measured Josiefied snapshot as an unselected TARGET_MEASURED candidate while binding exact artifact manifests; only then run a zero-cost matched selection pilot when an authorized execution surface exists, without touching the final holdout.
